title: skAIblock Modpack
description: A Modpack filled with Vibe Coded Mods
body:
# skAIblock Modpack

A Hypixel SkyBlock Modpack containing only AI Generated/Vibe Coded mods. Ranging from hallucinations pretending to be icons to code that barely compiles. For when you hate the environment, and affordable Computer Components.

### Key Features

- 100% Vibe-Coded: Every script was written by an AI guessing what Minecraft code looks like. They didn't check if it works. That would require effort, and who would do that.
- Hallucinated Features: Includes overlays that track stats the game doesn't have, wrongly even. If the mod says you have a drop chance of 140%, you should probably believe it.
- The Eco-Unfriendly Engine: Why use a single boolean when the AI can generate a 400-line neural network to check if you're holding a sword? It's not unoptimized, it's comprehensive.

---

### Disclaimer
This Modpack does not exist to flame the creators in any way. I am simply accepting the inevitable future where code is quantity over quality.
